sources.excerpt: Blossoming Chestnut Trees or Châtaigniers en fleurs is an 1890 painting by Vincent van Gogh. It was put up for auction at Sotheby's in New York City in November 2026.
On 18 November 2026, the work sold for US$190.4 million (including fees), setting a record for Van Gogh.
Art dealer Bill Acquavella placed the winning bid of US$165 million before fees. At the time, the sale made it the fourth most expensive painting sold at auction.

Vincent van Gogh's 1890 painting Blossoming Chestnut Trees sells for US$190.4 million at Sotheby's in New York City, United States, setting a new auction record for Van Gogh and surpassing the $117.2 million paid for Orchard with Cypresses (1888) in 2022.

In Test cricket, Bangladeshi wicketkeeper Litton Das sets a world record for the most dismissals in a single Test innings, recording six catches and two stumpings against South Africa in Johannesburg.
Litton Das effected eight dismissals in the second innings of the match, breaking the record for the most dismissals by a wicket-keeper in a Test innings.

The Philippines and Chile sign a free trade agreement as part of the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen, China, marking the former's first such agreement with a Latin American country.
Named Scaphokogia huachafo, the whale lived during the Late Miocene, between 6.3 and 5.6 million years ago, and measured approximately 2.7 meters in length.
Its fossilized skull displays the most extreme facial asymmetry known in any whale or dolphin, and possibly in any mammal.
The word huachafo comes from Peruvian Spanish and is commonly used to describe something excessively flashy, bizarre, extravagant, or even tacky.
